requirements_xml:
<requirements_list>
  <requirement id="R1">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The HTMLCanvasElement interface must define a captureStream() method that accepts an optional double frameRequestRate parameter and returns a MediaStream.</description>
    <spec_quote>partial interface HTMLCanvasElement {
    MediaStream captureStream (optional double frameRequestRate);
};</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R2">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack interface must be exposed on Window.</description>
    <spec_quote>[Exposed=Window] interface CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R3">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack interface must inherit from MediaStreamTrack.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack : MediaStreamTrack</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R4">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack interface must define a readonly canvas attribute of type HTMLCanvasElement.</description>
    <spec_quote>[Exposed=Window] interface CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack : MediaStreamTrack {
    readonly        attribute HTMLCanvasElement canvas;
    undefined requestFrame ();
};</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R5">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack interface must define a requestFrame() method that takes no parameters and returns undefined.</description>
    <spec_quote>[Exposed=Window] interface CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack : MediaStreamTrack {
    readonly        attribute HTMLCanvasElement canvas;
    undefined requestFrame ();
};</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R6">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling `captureStream()` on an `HTMLCanvasElement` must produce a real-time video capture of the canvas surface and return a `MediaStream` containing a single video `CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack`.</description>
    <spec_quote>The captureStream() method produces a real-time video
    capture of the surface of the canvas. The resulting media stream has a single video
    {{CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack}}</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R7">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>The `CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack` returned in the `MediaStream` from `captureStream()` must match the dimensions of the source `HTMLCanvasElement`.</description>
    <spec_quote>{{CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack}} that matches the dimensions of
    the canvas element.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R8">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>The readonly `canvas` attribute on a `CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack` must return the `HTMLCanvasElement` that the track captures.</description>
    <spec_quote>`canvas` of type {{HTMLCanvasElement}}, readonly
:   The canvas element that this media stream captures.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R9">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling `captureStream()` with a `frameRequestRate` of `0` must be supported to allow manual control of frame capture using `requestFrame()`.</description>
    <spec_quote>In order to support manual control of frame capture with the
    {{CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack/requestFrame}}() method, browsers MUST support a value of 0 for
    frameRequestRate.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R10">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When any new `CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack` is created, its `[[frameCaptureRequested]]` internal slot must be initialized to `true`.</description>
    <spec_quote>The value of {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} on all new
    tracks is set to `true` when the track is created.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R11">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>A captured stream must request capture of an initial frame when created even when `frameRequestRate` is `0`.</description>
    <spec_quote>However, a captured stream MUST request capture of a
    frame when created, even if frameRequestRate is zero.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R12">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When a captured track is created with a positive non-zero `frameRequestRate`, the user agent must start a periodic timer at an interval of `1/frameRequestRate` seconds that sets `[[frameCaptureRequested]]` to `true` on each activation.</description>
    <spec_quote>On creation of the
    captured track with a specific, non-zero frameRequestRate, the user
    agent starts a periodic timer at an interval of `1/frameRequestRate`
    seconds. At each activation of the timer,
    {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} is set to `true`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R13">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Each time the captured canvas is painted, for each track capturing from that canvas, if new content has been drawn since the canvas was last painted and `[[frameCaptureRequested]]` is `true`, a new frame containing what was painted must be added to the track.</description>
    <spec_quote>Each
    time that the captured canvas is painted, the following steps are executed:

    1. For each track capturing from the canvas execute the following
       steps:
       1. If new content has been drawn to the canvas since it was last painted, and
          if the {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} internal slot of
          track is set, add a new frame to track containing what
          was painted to the canvas.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R14">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When the captured canvas is painted, if a `frameRequestRate` value was specified for the track, the track's `[[frameCaptureRequested]]` internal slot must be set to `false` (whereas omitting `frameRequestRate` leaves it `true` so subsequent paints continue capturing frames).</description>
    <spec_quote>If a frameRequestRate value was specified, set the
          {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} internal slot of track
          to `false`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R15">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When adding new frames to a track captured from a canvas that is not fully opaque, the alpha channel content of the canvas must be captured and preserved.</description>
    <spec_quote>When adding new frames to track containing what was painted to the
    canvas, the alpha channel content of the canvas must be captured and preserved if
    the canvas is not fully opaque.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R16">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling `requestFrame()` on a `CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack` must manually request that a frame from the canvas be captured and rendered into the track.</description>
    <spec_quote>The requestFrame() method allows applications to manually
    request that a frame from the canvas be captured and rendered into the track.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R17">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling captureStream() on a canvas element that is not origin-clean must throw a SecurityError exception.</description>
    <spec_quote>This method throws a {{SecurityError}}
    exception if the canvas is not origin-clean.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R18">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the origin-clean flag of the source canvas element becomes false after a stream has been created by captureStream(), the captured stream must immediately stop capturing content from the canvas.</description>
    <spec_quote>A captured stream MUST immediately cease to capture content if the
    [= origin-clean =] flag of the source canvas becomes false after the stream is
    created by {{HTMLCanvasElement/captureStream()}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R19">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If the origin-clean flag of the source canvas element becomes false after a stream has been created by captureStream(), the captured MediaStreamTrack must become muted and produce no new content while the canvas remains not origin-clean.</description>
    <spec_quote>The captured {{MediaStreamTrack}}
    MUST become muted, producing no new content while the canvas remains in this
    state.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R20">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling captureStream() on a canvas element with a negative frameRequestRate value must throw a NotSupportedError exception.</description>
    <spec_quote>This method throws a {{NotSupportedError}} if frameRequestRate is negative.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R21">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>If the origin-clean flag of the source canvas becomes false after a MediaStream is created via captureStream(), the captured stream must immediately cease capturing content from the canvas.</description>
    <spec_quote>A captured stream MUST immediately cease to capture content if the
    [= origin-clean =] flag of the source canvas becomes false after the stream is
    created by {{HTMLCanvasElement/captureStream()}}.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R22">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>If the origin-clean flag of the source canvas becomes false after a MediaStream is created via captureStream(), the captured MediaStreamTrack must transition to the muted state and produce no new content while the canvas remains not origin-clean.</description>
    <spec_quote>A captured stream MUST immediately cease to capture content if the
    [= origin-clean =] flag of the source canvas becomes false after the stream is
    created by {{HTMLCanvasElement/captureStream()}}. The captured {{MediaStreamTrack}}
    MUST become muted, producing no new content while the canvas remains in this
    state.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R23">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>When a new frame is requested from a captured canvas (such as via requestFrame()), the capturing track's [[frameCaptureRequested]] internal slot must be updated to true.</description>
    <spec_quote>Each track that captures a canvas has a
    {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} internal slot that is set to `true` when a
    new frame is requested from the canvas.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R24">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>When a captured track is created with a specific non-zero frameRequestRate, a periodic timer running at an interval of 1/frameRequestRate seconds must set the track's [[frameCaptureRequested]] internal slot to true upon each timer activation.</description>
    <spec_quote>On creation of the
    captured track with a specific, non-zero frameRequestRate, the user
    agent starts a periodic timer at an interval of `1/frameRequestRate`
    seconds. At each activation of the timer,
    {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} is set to `true`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R25">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>Each time a captured canvas is painted, for each track capturing from that canvas, a new frame containing what was painted must be added to the track if and only if new content has been drawn to the canvas since it was last painted and the track's [[frameCaptureRequested]] internal slot is true.</description>
    <spec_quote>Each
    time that the captured canvas is painted, the following steps are executed:

    1. For each track capturing from the canvas execute the following
       steps:
       1. If new content has been drawn to the canvas since it was last painted, and
          if the {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} internal slot of
          track is set, add a new frame to track containing what
          was painted to the canvas.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R26">
    <category>Invalidation</category>
    <description>Each time a captured canvas is painted, for each capturing track that was created with a frameRequestRate argument specified, the track's [[frameCaptureRequested]] internal slot must be reset to false.</description>
    <spec_quote>Each
    time that the captured canvas is painted, the following steps are executed:

    1. For each track capturing from the canvas execute the following
       steps:
       1. If new content has been drawn to the canvas since it was last painted, and
          if the {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} internal slot of
          track is set, add a new frame to track containing what
          was painted to the canvas.
       2. If a frameRequestRate value was specified, set the
          {{track/[[frameCaptureRequested]]}} internal slot of track
          to `false`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
</requirements_list>
